Antigravity now tells you what it needs before an agent can use it.

## What's in 1.14.1

**Install first, then sign in.** The Antigravity CLI (`agy`) is not part of the KyoubeAI image, but Antigravity shows on an agent's **Runtime** tab with its models from the start, so it was easy to set up an agent with no `agy` behind it. **Test** on that tab now says when `agy` is not installed and that `kyoube harness install agy` in the Terminal installs it. Once it is installed, Test says whether it is signed in and how to sign in: run `agy` in the Terminal, choose **Google OAuth**, open the link it prints, sign in and paste the code back. A run that fails for either reason now says the same.

**Where to sign in.** In the Terminal (the **Workspace** page, then **Terminal**). There is no sign-in on the agent page for Antigravity: the core's sign-in panel only appears for agents that run in a managed sandbox. The [README](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/README.md#antigravity-cli) has the steps.

## Update

From 1.14.0, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.14.0. The bundled Antigravity adapter moves to 0.1.1 on the first start.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
